import torchimport torch.nn as nnfrom torch_geometric.nn import GCNConvclass GridGNN(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, in_channels):        super().__init__()        self.conv1 = GCNConv(in_channels, 32)        self.conv2 = GCNConv(32, 16)        self.out = nn.Linear(16, 1)    def forward(self, x, edge_index):        x = self.conv1(x, edge_index)        x = torch.relu(x)        x = self.conv2(x, edge_index)        x = torch.relu(x)        return self.out(x)

relevantExcerpts: bitna razlika između “ima MQTT mogućnost” i “full MQTT broker platforme”.
Kratko: CrateDB nema MQTT broker. On može primati podatke koji dolaze iz MQTT-a, ali ne zamjenjuje broker poput EMQX-a.
ali ne radi MQTT routing, session management ni device management

[Locust simulacija]        ↓ MQTT   ┌──────────────┐   │   EMQX       │  ← MQTT broker (routing)   └──────────────┘        ↓ Rule Engine / Connector   ┌──────────────┐   │   CrateDB    │  ← storage + analytics   └──────────────┘        ↓ FastAPI / AI / Vue dashboard
direkt MQTT client → custom consumer → CrateDB
CrateDB = mozak (storage + AI + analytics)EMQX = živčani sustav (MQTT komunikacija)Locust = generator svijeta (trafostanice)
može se napraviti CrateDB ↔ EMQX integracija, ali bitno je razumjeti jednu stvar:
ne postoji “native CrateDB connector” u EMQX-u kao službeni plug-and-play driver ali EMQX je dizajniran da se lako povezuje s bazama kroz Rules Engine + Actions
CrateDB ima PostgreSQL wire protocol, pa EMQX ne treba “poseban driver”.
MQTT Devices (Locust)        ↓   EMQX Broker        ↓ Rule Engine (SQL transform)        ↓PostgreSQL Connector        ↓     CrateDB
